truth (issue #1118): stopped() that reads !saveTicket.isExpired() before cancel() and then calls station.save()
in a try/catch that logs (the exemplar of types/dashboard.md § Write path) has no row. A flush through a helper
method that saves (flushSave() in Other.java) counts the same. A cancel() in a comment is not code.
-- args --
@DIR@/Mod
-- want --
exit 0
-- stderr --
-- Mod/Mod-ux/src/com/x/ux/BDashServlet.java --
package com.x.ux;
public final class BDashServlet extends BWebServlet {
  private final Object saveLock = new Object();
  private Clock.Ticket saveTicket = Clock.expiredTicket;
  void requestSave(BStation station, long delay) {
    saveTicket = Clock.schedule(station, BRelTime.make(Math.max(delay, 1L)), BStation.save, null);
  }
  @Override public void stopped() throws Exception {
    synchronized (saveLock) {
      boolean pending = !saveTicket.isExpired();
      saveTicket.cancel();
      if (pending) {
        try {
          Sys.getStation().save();
        } catch (Exception e) {
          LOG.warning("station save at stop failed: " + e);
        }
      }
    }
    super.stopped();
  }
}
-- Mod/Mod-ux/src/com/x/ux/Other.java --
package com.x.ux;
public final class Other extends BWebServlet {
  private Clock.Ticket saveTicket = Clock.expiredTicket;
  void flushSave() {
    try { Sys.getStation().save(); } catch (Exception e) { LOG.warning("save failed: " + e); }
  }
  @Override public void stopped() throws Exception {
    // saveTicket.cancel() is dropped on purpose
    boolean pending = !saveTicket.isExpired();
    saveTicket.cancel();
    if (pending) flushSave();
    super.stopped();
  }
}
